# Free MD Viewer

> A free, open-source markdown viewer and editor that runs entirely in the
> browser. It opens local .md files, renders them, and saves edits back to the
> original file. Nothing is uploaded: there is no server, no account, and no
> upload endpoint, so documents never leave the user's device.

Free MD Viewer is one self-contained HTML file with every dependency embedded,
so it also runs offline from disk. It is MIT licensed and the source is public.
It is made by Kingsbridge Consultancy LLC.

## Key facts

- Price: free. No ads, no account, no paid tier, no watermarks, no page limits.
- Privacy: renders locally in the browser; the file is never transmitted anywhere.
- Install: optional. Works as a web page; can be installed in Chrome or Edge so
  .md files open in it on double-click, and then works offline.
- Editing: Save writes back to the original file via the File System Access API
  in Chrome and Edge; other browsers fall back to downloading a copy.
- Markdown support: GitHub-flavored markdown (tables, task lists, strikethrough,
  fenced code), footnotes, GitHub callouts, Mermaid diagrams, LaTeX math via
  KaTeX, and syntax highlighting via highlight.js.
- Other features: open several files at once in tabs, find and replace, a table
  of contents, reader controls, copy buttons on code blocks, per-diagram SVG and
  per-table CSV download, and detection of edits made by another editor.
- Export: self-contained HTML, PNG of the rendered page, and PDF through the
  browser's print dialog (selectable text, not a screenshot).
- Builds: the full build is ~3.7 MB; a "lite" build without Mermaid and KaTeX is
  ~287 KB, for people who write neither.

## Pages

- [Home](https://freemdviewer.com/): what it does, how it works, features, privacy, FAQ.
- [The viewer](https://freemdviewer.com/app/): the app itself — open a .md file and read or edit it.
